name: JG_FSCL_HDR_DTLS_ATRB_INT
description: This interface table contains multiple instances of records associated with the header of a transaction e.g. licence plate details of the trucks carrying the goods. This table would be used with Fiscal Document Capture and Receivables applications to receive additional attributes for interfaced transactions.

columns.name: HDR_ATRB_DTL_INT_ID
columns.description: Unique legal message identifier for a transaction.

columns.name: INTERFACE_HDR_ID
columns.description: Interface header identifier of the document.

columns.name: APP_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name of the transaction.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: This identifies the record type of the header details, for example, a record for License plate details or for providing additional information about the tax payer.

columns.name: HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE1
columns.description: First value for a specific record type, for example, license plate number.

columns.name: HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE2
columns.description: Second value for a specific record type, for example, license plate issuing state.

columns.name: HEADER_DETAIL_ATTRIBUTE3
columns.description: Third value for a specific record type, for example, license plate registration number.
